title: 第十三章 真糖第十四章 你能怎样
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
温晚意并没有在督星办待多久，毕竟她当初真没那个意思，是那个女生自己理解错了，进而做出了过激的行为。
可她还是觉得不可饶恕。
那个女生是，唐斩月更是！
从督星办出来，温晚意毫不犹豫地给一个匿名账号发了条消息。
[你说的条件，我可以答应。前提是，让唐斩月彻底消失。]
[如你所愿。]
温晚意盯着这条回应看了许久，然后将这两条消息删除，疲惫地叹了口气。
最初她只是想好好学习，靠自己的努力实现阶级跨越，之后莫名被贺兰逸他们偏宠，她发现这样的方式能让她更快达成目的。
随之而来的还有源源不断的恶意与诱惑，她动摇过，但还是拒绝了，她承担不起失败的后果。
但现在，她已经没有其他路可走了。
联邦军校。
唐斩月无奈再次拒绝了叶峥的邀约。
没办法，她身为插班生，要补的基础知识实在太多，想要尽快跟上大家的进度，必须抓紧一切时间学习。
暧昧对象，复仇对象，全都得靠边站。
好在江眠夏还留着当初的学习笔记，并且毫不吝啬地全发给了她。
唐斩月感动地回赠她一个稀有金属大礼包，为她的课题研究添砖加瓦。
江眠夏激动得不行，当场发誓要成为“真糖”的第一粉头！
唐斩月茫然，“真糖是什么？”
“你和叶峥的cp名啊！”江眠夏骄傲挺胸，“我起的！是不是很贴切？”
唐斩月嘴角抽了抽，“你喜欢就好。”顿了下，她善意提醒，“嗑cp别太当真，要是我们没在一起……”

“不可能！”江眠夏神情认真，“我相信叶少将！”
唐斩月沉默，没好意思说她是不相信自己。
第二天上午要进行机甲训练赛的观摩。
想成为机甲工程师，必须要先了解机甲的战斗方式，才能真正更新迭代，制造出更优秀、更先进的机甲。
这节也是大课，整个系的学生都要到场。
不出意外的，温晚意也在，但令人诧异的是，她身边竟然站着裴烬川。
“裴总竟然来了！”
“听说他的精神体是黄金狮子，精神力和体质都是双s级，就算不当裴氏总裁，上了战场肯定也很优秀。”
“温晚意命可真好，即便没了唐家大小姐的身份，也还有这么高质量的追求者。”
“听说裴总上个月给学校捐了十台新型机甲，今天八成是来视察的。”
“什么视察，我看他就是来给温晚意撑腰的，这段时间温晚意的日子可不好过……”
……
唐斩月了然，原来是赞助商。
她将目光转到赛场边缘的机甲上，几个工程师正在给机甲替换能量块。
能量块大概人头大小，主要为机甲上的武器提供能源。
能量块的等级，会对机甲本身的战斗力产生影响。
所以工程师们会在训练赛开始前，统一更换同一批次的能量块，将影响降到最低。
参加训练赛的学生们陆续入场，领头的赫然是联邦最年轻的少将，叶峥。
前来观摩的学生们眼睛一亮，尖叫声瞬间冲顶，不管是女生还是男生都大喊着叶峥的名字，再也没人关注裴烬川。
content_en:
Wen Wanyi didn't stay at the Governor's Office for long. After all, she really didn't mean it at the beginning. It was the girl who misunderstood it and acted excessively.
But she still felt unforgivable.
That girl is, and Tang Zhanyue is even more so!
After leaving the Governor's Office, Wen Wanyi sent a message to an anonymous account without hesitation.
[I can agree to the conditions you mentioned. The premise is that Tang Zhanyue disappears completely. ]
[As you wish. ]
Wen Wanyi stared at this response for a long time, then deleted the two messages and sighed tiredly.
At first, she just wanted to study hard and achieve a class leap through her own efforts. Later, she was inexplicably favored by He Lanyi and the others. She found that this method could help her achieve her goal faster.
What followed was a steady stream of malice and temptation. She wavered, but still refused. She could not afford the consequences of failure.
But now, she has no other choice.
Federal Military Academy.
Tang Zhanyue had no choice but to reject Ye Zheng's invitation again.
There was no other way. As a transfer student, she had too much basic knowledge to catch up on. If she wanted to keep up with everyone's progress as soon as possible, she had to seize all the time to study.
The objects of ambiguity and revenge must all be put aside.
Fortunately, Jiang Mianxia still kept the original study notes and sent them all to her without hesitation.
Tang Zhanyue was moved and gave her a gift package of rare metals to contribute to her research.
Jiang Mianxia was so excited that she vowed on the spot to become the number one fan of "Real Candy"!
Tang Zhanyue was confused, "What is real candy?"
"You and Ye Zheng's CP names!" Jiang Mianxia proudly puffed out her chest, "I named them! Isn't it very appropriate?"
The corner of Tang Zhanyue's mouth twitched, "As long as you like it." After a pause, she kindly reminded, "Don't take CP smoking too seriously. If we weren't together..."
"Impossible!" Jiang Mianxia looked serious, "I believe Major General Ye!"
Tang Zhanyue was silent, embarrassed to say that she didn't believe him.
The next morning there will be a mecha training match to observe.
If you want to become a mecha engineer, you must first understand how mechas fight before you can truly update and iterate to create better and more advanced mechas.
This is also a big class, and students from the entire department must be present.
As expected, Wen Wanyi was also there, but what was surprising was that Pei Jinchuan was standing next to her.
"Mr. Pei is here!"
"I heard that his mental body is a golden lion, and his mental strength and physical strength are double S-level. Even if he is not the president of the Pei family, he will definitely be very good on the battlefield."
"Wen Wan has such a good destiny. Even without her status as the eldest lady of the Tang family, she still has such high-quality suitors."
"I heard that President Pei donated ten new mechas to the school last month. Most of them are here for inspection today."
"What kind of inspection? I think he is here to support Wen Wanyi. Wen Wanyi is not having a good time during this period..."
…
Tang Zhanyue understood that he was originally a sponsor.
She turned her attention to the mecha on the edge of the arena. Several engineers were replacing energy blocks on the mecha.
The energy block is about the size of a human head and mainly provides energy for the weapons on the mecha.
The level of the energy block will affect the combat effectiveness of the mecha itself.
Therefore, engineers will uniformly replace the energy blocks of the same batch before the start of the training match to minimize the impact.
The students participating in the training match entered one after another, and the leader was the youngest major general in the Federation, Ye Zheng.
The eyes of the students who came to watch lit up, and their screams suddenly reached the top. Both girls and boys shouted Ye Zheng's name, and no one paid attention to Pei Jinchuan anymore.
